drivers: Gulf of Mexico storm shut-ins and Saudi refinery attack reports
Americas heavy oil glut from freight squeeze
Petcoke-to-coal switching getting closer
outlooks.summary: Mixed news: storm shut-ins and Middle East attacks are bullish, but a heavy-oil glut in the Americas and coal switching limit upside. Price is down 16% over 3 months and the supply score is near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how long US Gulf production stays shut and whether the Ras Tanura attack hits refinery output.
outlooks.summary_zh: 消息好坏参半:墨西哥湾风暴停产和中东袭击偏利多,但美洲重油过剩及转用煤炭会限制上行空间。价格三个月下跌16%,供应压力得分接近零。
drivers_zh: 墨西哥湾风暴停产及沙特炼厂遇袭报道
运费紧张导致美洲重油过剩
石油焦转向煤炭的临界点临近
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾停产持续多久,以及拉斯坦努拉遇袭是否影响炼厂产量。

drivers: Fed rate-hike fears and strong dollar
Gold at 14-month low after sharp sell-off
ETF outflows
outlooks.summary: Headlines are about macro-driven price falls, not supply shortages. No supply-shortage case for upside; the news points to continued weakness.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the next Fed signals and US dollar and yield moves.
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻主要是宏观因素导致的价格下跌,而非供应短缺。看不到供应短缺带来的上行风险,消息面指向价格持续疲弱。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息担忧与美元走强
黄金大幅下跌至14个月低点
ETF资金流出
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美联储下一步信号以及美元和收益率走势。

drivers: DRC reinstates cobalt export ban from 30 November
Four-month ban announced to counter price collapse
China prices at three-month high
outlooks.summary: The DRC, the top supplier, is halting exports again for about four months. Prices fell 24% in 3 months, so the ban has room to push them up, though Chinese stockpiling ahead of the ban may soften the near-term effect.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the 30 November start date, any quota or exemption details, and Chinese inventory levels.
outlooks.summary_zh: 最大供应国刚果(金)将再次暂停出口约四个月。价格三个月已下跌24%,禁令有推升空间,但中国企业赶在禁令前囤货可能削弱短期影响。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)自11月30日起恢复钴出口禁令
宣布为期四个月的禁令以应对价格暴跌
中国钴价升至三个月高点
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注11月30日生效情况、配额或豁免细则以及中国库存水平。

drivers: Thailand chemical export ban (indirect)
China extends export-control suspension to US
Copper smelter squeeze and Chile output lows
outlooks.summary: No direct molybdenum supply news. Weak links to copper by-product output are bullish, but China's suspension extension is bearish. Price is already up 18% in 3 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Chilean and other copper mine output, since molybdenum is largely a by-product.
outlooks.summary_zh: 没有直接涉及钼供应的消息。铜副产品产量偏紧的间接关联偏利多,但中国延长出口管制暂停偏利空。价格三个月已上涨18%。
drivers_zh: 泰国化学品出口禁令(间接影响)
中国延长对美出口管制暂停
铜冶炼紧张及智利产量低迷
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注智利及其他铜矿产量,因为钼主要是副产品。

drivers: Zimbabwe export tax and 2027 ban plan
CATL restarts Jianxiawo mine
Prices consolidating at lows, weak demand
outlooks.summary: Zimbabwe policy is supportive, but the CATL mine restart and weak end-use demand offset it. Price is down 13% in 3 months with no clear shortage.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Zimbabwe's final export rules and whether the Jianxiawo restart holds.
outlooks.summary_zh: 津巴布韦政策偏利多,但宁德时代矿山复产和终端需求疲弱起到抵消作用。价格三个月下跌13%,没有明确的短缺迹象。
drivers_zh: 津巴布韦出口税及2027年禁令计划
宁德时代枧下窝锂矿复产
价格低位盘整,需求疲弱
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注津巴布韦最终出口规则以及枧下窝复产能否持续。

drivers: China expands rare earth export controls
Thailand to ban mining chemical exports to Myanmar
Laos rare earth operations suspended after dam breach
outlooks.summary: Several supply risks stack up: tighter Chinese controls, Thai chemical curbs hitting Myanmar mining, and a Laos suspension. Price is up 36% over 12 months, so some of this may be priced in, but more upside is plausible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Myanmar output after the Thai ban and how long the Laos suspension lasts.
outlooks.summary_zh: 多重供应风险叠加:中国加强管制、泰国化学品禁令冲击缅甸稀土开采,以及老挝停产。价格12个月上涨36%,部分可能已被消化,但仍有进一步上行可能。
drivers_zh: 中国扩大稀土出口管制
泰国禁止向缅甸出口采矿化学品
老挝溃坝后稀土作业暂停
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注泰国禁令后缅甸产量,以及老挝停产持续时间。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts
Thailand chemical ban affecting Myanmar mining
China export-control suspension extended (bearish)
outlooks.summary: Tight supply from Congo and Indonesia and possible Myanmar disruption support prices. Price is up 56% in 12 months but flat over 3 months, so risk is moderately upward.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export data and Myanmar output after the Thai chemical ban.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)和印尼供应紧张,加上缅甸可能受扰,支撑价格。价格12个月上涨56%,但三个月基本持平,上行风险适中。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)冲突与印尼减产
泰国化学品禁令影响缅甸矿业
中国延长出口管制暂停(利空)
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口数据以及泰国化学品禁令后缅甸的产量。

drivers: Major Chinese antimony mine halts production
China extends export-ban pause for US to 27 January
Price down 56% in 12 months
outlooks.summary: A mine halt is bullish, but China's extended pause on export curbs to the US is bearish. Prices have fallen sharply, so the market is not showing a shortage.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how long the Chinese mine stays offline and what happens before the 27 January expiry.
outlooks.summary_zh: 矿山停产偏利多,但中国延长对美出口管制暂停偏利空。价格大幅下跌,市场未显示短缺。
drivers_zh: 中国一大型锑矿停产
中国将对美出口禁令暂停延至1月27日
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注该中国矿山停产时长以及1月27日到期前的动向。

drivers: China extends export-ban pause to 27 January
Licences still required
Price up 67% in 3 months
outlooks.summary: The pause on curbs to the US eases pressure, but licences are still needed. Price has already jumped 67% in 3 months, so much shortage risk looks priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch for any change in China's policy before the 27 January expiry.
outlooks.summary_zh: 对美管制暂停缓解了压力,但仍需许可证。价格三个月已大涨67%,短缺风险似乎已大部分被消化。
drivers_zh: 中国将出口禁令暂停延至1月27日
仍需许可证
价格三个月上涨67%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注1月27日到期前中国政策是否变化。

drivers: Gulf storm shut-ins and Saudi refinery attack reports
Heavy oil glut in the Americas
Rally pushing coal switching
outlooks.summary: Raw-material supply news is mixed: outages are bullish, while the Americas glut and coal switching are bearish. Price is up 15%, and the supply score is near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Gulf Coast refinery restarts after the storm and Middle East refinery output.
outlooks.summary_zh: 原料供应消息好坏参半:停产偏利多,美洲过剩和转用煤炭偏利空。价格上涨15%,供应压力得分接近零。
drivers_zh: 墨西哥湾风暴停产及沙特炼厂遇袭报道
美洲重油过剩
涨价推动转用煤炭
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注风暴后墨西哥湾沿岸炼厂复产情况以及中东炼厂产量。

drivers: Gulf storm shut-ins and Saudi refinery attack reports
Heavy oil glut in the Americas
Petcoke-to-coal discount narrowing
outlooks.summary: Mixed headlines with a near-zero supply score. Price is down 5% over 3 months but up 46% over 12 months, so much upside looks already priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch US Gulf production recovery and the petcoke-to-coal price gap.
outlooks.summary_zh: 消息好坏参半,供应压力得分接近零。价格三个月下跌5%,但12个月上涨46%,大部分上行似乎已被消化。
drivers_zh: 墨西哥湾风暴停产及沙特炼厂遇袭报道
美洲重油过剩
石油焦与煤炭价差收窄
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾产量恢复情况以及石油焦与煤炭的价差。
